General situation","publisher":"EUAA","date":"2025-01","url":"https://www.euaa.europa.eu/country-guidance-iran-2025/641-general-situation","summary":"Published in January 2025 but summarizing conditions as of September 2024, this source says primary healthcare was generally free, and urban water supply/sanitation had improved somewhat. It also says food security was threatened, about 30 percent of the population lived below the poverty line, housing was unaffordable for many, and informal settlements had poor sanitary conditions and irregular access to water/heating.
